title: Indoor solar lights for the boys' dormitories
summary:
A Silver Jubilee project with the Menda Foundation, lighting every boys' dormitory.
The 1989–1996 batch contributed ₹2,50,000 towards providing indoor solar lighting for the boys' dormitory at JNV Chikkamagaluru, supporting better lighting facilities for residential students.
body:
## Solar Lighting for Boys’ Dormitories at JNV Balehonnur

All boys’ dormitories at Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV), Balehonnur, were provided with solar lighting through the generous contributions of the JNVCKM alumni. The initiative was undertaken by the **4th Batch**, marking 25 years since joining the school, and the **8th Batch (1989–1996)** in association with the Menda Foundation, Bengaluru.

Recognising the importance of a comfortable, safe and well-lit residential environment, the 1989–1996 batch contributed **₹2,50,000 towards indoor solar lighting** for the boys’ dormitories.

This initiative addressed an essential everyday need of students residing on campus while promoting the use of renewable energy. The installation of solar lights has helped improve dormitory lighting facilities and contributed to creating a more comfortable living environment for present and future Navodayans.

The project stands as a testament to the enduring bond between alumni and their alma mater, demonstrating how collective efforts and meaningful contributions can make a lasting difference in the lives of students.

**Total Investment: ₹2.50 Lakhs**
